short: The free listing that puts a business on Google Search and Maps.
seoTitle: Google Business Profile — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: A Google Business Profile is the free listing that shows a business on Google Search and Maps, carrying its address, hours, photos, reviews and links.
definition: A Google Business Profile is the free listing that shows a business on Google Search and Maps, carrying its address, hours, photos, reviews and links. For local businesses it is often the single largest source of discovery.
bodyHtml:
Why Google Business Profile matters

Most local searches end at the map pack, not at a website. An incomplete or outdated profile loses customers who were already looking for exactly what you sell.

How Google Business Profile works in practice

Keep hours accurate — especially on holidays — add photos regularly, and reply to reviews. Categories and service attributes decide which searches you appear in, so they are worth setting carefully.

faq.question: Does a Google Business Profile cost anything?
faq.answer: No. It is free, and for most local businesses it outperforms paid advertising for discovery.

faq.question: How do I improve local ranking?
faq.answer: Complete information, consistent name and address across the web, regular photos, and a steady flow of genuine reviews.
